verdict.rationale: Customer.io ships an official MCP server that lets an AI client "work with segments" through natural-language prompts, and its docs say a connected AI client can "build segments." A CLI also gives agents full API access with self-describing schemas, and the in-app "Describe segment" agent turns plain-text descriptions into segments. Missing for 10: documentation of the specific segment-creation endpoint/condition schema exposed via MCP/CLI, and independent or hands-on corroboration that agent-built segments work as claimed.
